stem: Why can a two-stage wake-word/full-ASR design suit a resource-constrained mobile robot?

options.text: Local wake detection requires every later language stage to share its device
A lightweight detector gates the more expensive full recognizer
Full ASR runs on all ambient speech first, and the wake detector merely labels its transcripts
The wake detector reduces the full recognizer’s cost per active audio frame by shrinking the recognizer’s vocabulary.
